# Pinterest

> Pinterest is a visual discovery and content sharing platform that enables users to find, save, and share ideas through pins, with comprehensive tools for analytics, advertising, and business growth.

Pinterest serves as a hub for creative inspiration and product discovery, offering both organic content sharing and paid advertising solutions. The platform provides businesses with analytics dashboards, audience targeting capabilities, and expert consultation services to maximize engagement and campaign performance.

## Key Topics

- Pins
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest Ads
- Analytics Dashboard
- Engagement Metrics
- Audience Insights
- Pin Performance
- Campaign Management
- Audience Targeting
- Business Growth
- Content Strategy
- Advertising Platform
- Expert Program
- Pin Creation
- Business Tools

## Analytics & Performance Tracking

- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com/): Pinterest Analytics dashboard for tracking pin performance and audience insights

## Advertising & Business Solutions

- [Pinterest Ads](https://ads.pinterest.com/expert/): Pinterest Ads expert program offering consultation and campaign management tools
